topic.title: Data Centres / AI Growth Zones / Critical Infrastructure
topic.source_contract: site and operator, IT load, power connection, backup generation, water and cooling, resilience, planning or NSIP route, AI Growth Zone status, environmental effects, construction, commissioning and live-service evidence

scope_guards: An AI Growth Zone designation is not treated as planning permission.
A grid connection request is not treated as secured energisation.
Rated IT load is not treated as live customer capacity.
A water-demand forecast is not treated as an agreed supply.
A planning permission is not treated as constructed data halls.
Installed equipment is not treated as commissioned resilient service.
A critical-infrastructure designation is not treated as compliance with all security duties.
No score or promotion is written without exact consents, utilities, construction, commissioning, resilience testing and live service.
